epistemic_assessments.rationale: tda-tor-v4 is the terms of reference in force from 2024-09-01 and states this purpose.
Items 2 and 4 of the 2026-02-11 pack and minutes: 21 changes assessed against four testable standards, 12+9 requiring no discussion.
The secretariat confirmed 3 analyst-days across four systems to assemble the conformance dashboard, as in prior months.
Item 3 minutes record a contested weighing of contact effectiveness against data minimisation, with named disagreement.
Two Standard 7 non-conformances noted and returned to delivery teams.
The retention question was routed onward to the Data Governance Council.
The Authority is minuted approving at Gate 2 and the terms of reference reserve Gate 2 to it; that it exercised the power is evidenced, that it was entitled to is not separately established.
Challenge is stated in the terms of reference and one instance is minuted; no source establishes what happens where the Authority's challenge is not accepted.
No source addresses whether the Authority may halt an in-flight change.

stated_purpose: Assure that material change is architecturally coherent, strategically aligned and consistent with the target architecture

inferred_jobs.description: Assessment of changes against Architecture Standards 3, 7, 9 and 11, which have defined pass criteria. 12 conforming changes and 9 standard patterns required no discussion.
The estate conformance dashboard, assembled by hand across four systems before each meeting.
inferred_jobs.time_share_observed: 3 analyst-days per cycle, outside the meeting

inferred_jobs.description: Contact effectiveness against the data minimisation position, where the model requires transaction-level features. Genuinely cross-domain and without defined pass criteria.
Two Standard 7 non-conformances returned to delivery teams for rework.
The Ashcombe retention question routed onward to the Data Governance Council.

payload.challenge_role: Stated as architectural challenge in the terms of reference; one instance evidenced in six meetings of sampled minutes.
manual_reconstruction_steps: Conformance dashboard assembled across four systems, 3 analyst-days per cycle
Ashcombe pack prepared separately from the risk forum pack despite shared content

execution_authority.basis: tda-tor-v4 section 5 reserves Gate 2 to the Authority; the 2026-02-11 minutes evidence its exercise

challenge_authority.basis: Terms of reference; one minuted instance

independence_assessment.reporting: Not established by any supplied source.
independence_assessment.evidence_source: The conformance dashboard and the design pack are both prepared by the delivery teams whose changes are being assessed.
independence_assessment.orchestration: The secretariat sets the agenda; who directs the secretariat is not established.

required_authority: Amendment of tda-tor-v4 would be required for any change to what the Authority may delegate. No source in the estate establishes who holds that authority.
caveat: This reconstructs what the Authority is evidenced to do. It establishes nothing about whether it is entitled to do it, and nothing about whether it should continue to.
prohibited_inference: That the stated purpose describes what the forum does
That approval by the Authority proves entitlement to approve
That an unresolved power rests with the Chair or the most senior member
